newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nail,GFSA talks "still at formative stage".
newsitem.headline: Nail,GFSA talks "still at formative stage".

text.p: Talks between South African black investment group New Africa Investments Ltd (Nail) and mining house Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd were still at a formative stage, Nail chairman Cyril Ramaphosa said on Monday.
Last month Nail said it was in talks to buy an effective 17.2 percent stake in the mining group, giving it joint control with Rembrandt Group Ltd, which already owns a similar stake.
"We are still at the ground floor," Ramaphosa said during a briefing with reporters.
While the company would make an announcement in the future, he could not put any timeframe on when this could be expected.
If successful, the deal would mark a further big advance for black business in South Africa and a significant coup for Nail which already has control of industrial group Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd.
